message.content: [罪名]侵犯注册商标专用权罪<eoa>
message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on facts: Qin produced and sold counterfeit goods bearing a registered trademark "ISSEYMIYAKE". This is trademark infringement and counterfeiting. Under Chinese criminal law, the crime is "侵犯注册商标专用权罪" (Trademark infringement). Also "生产、销售假冒注册商标的商品罪". The specific article: Criminal Law Article 210 (2) for manufacturing and selling counterfeit goods. So the crime is "侵犯注册商标专用权罪". Also possibly "非法经营罪"? But the facts only support trademark infringement. So answer: [罪名]侵犯注册商标专用权罪<eoa>.

Check if multiple: Could be "生产、销售假冒注册商标的商品罪" is same as above. In Chinese law, the crime is "侵犯注册商标专用权罪". So single.

Thus final.
